name: Queer Ranch Festival
description: Queer Ranch arrives in Berlin for the first time, bringing its Lesbos-born celebration of queer country and dance music to the banks of the Spree. The Sunday day party runs from 15:00 to midnight at Fitzroy Club, with a lineup including Snack2Snack, Tamarr, Immy, Pepiita b2b Sanaz (surf2glory), and Softchaos. The event represents a fascinating collision of queer culture and Americana aesthetics, subverting country music's conservative associations while creating space for joy, weirdness, and collective celebration. Cancel your hangover and bring your weird self—hydration recommended.
